meta.description: Laid over the invented creation sample (m5b-creation.fixture.json) by the layout harness's ?creation=full world, so guided creation reaches every step: an invented patron for the Reed Witch, behind its own option (the Patron step), and a table of odds and ends the Gear step picks from (its pick sheet). harnessRulesSet is not part of the pack format: the harness adds its keys to the sample's rules set.
